title: Anthony Davis Turns Heads After Revealing Longstanding Dream of Teaming Up With Luka Doncic - NewsBreak
text:
By Kenny Nosay ,
1 hours ago
Luka Doncic and Anthony Davis (Photo by Imagn Images) Washington Wizards big man Anthony Davis has had a whirlwind of a year. He went from playing for the Lakers to the Mavericks and then to the Wizards in a flash.
Dallas even kept AD in the dark when they traded him to Washington. As one of the best big men in the league, that’s quite an odd happenstance. But before the hectic year he’s gone through, he’s longed to play alongside one particular player – Luka Doncic. The one-time champ has gone on record that he’s a huge fan of Luka’s game.
“Luka is so cold, bro. We used to talk about Luka all the time. Be like, ‘Imagine me with Luka… oh my God,” Anthony Davis said on the Draymond Green Show.
Sadly enough, the basketball gods did not have the pairing on their cards. The two were infamously traded for each other, ending any chance of them playing together on the same team. Maybe AD can work something out with Trae Young next season?
Fans Call for Anthony Davis to Come Back to LA Many Laker fans still hold Davis close to their hearts. After hearing what he had to say, fans went on X to express their desire for Anthony Davis to come back to LA.
“You can always come back home,” a fan said.
“Luka and AD combo will feed families,” a fan commented.
“AD said ‘Luka is so cold, bro.’ When TWO superstars fantasize about playing together, you KNOW the league missed something special. Luka’s gravity + AD’s rim running? UNSTOPPABLE,” another fan said.
“Come back to LA brother,” another fan commented.
“Anthony Davis back to the lakers confirmed,” a fan said.
Will AD go back to play in LA and partner up with Luka Doncic? He’ll have a chance to do so in 2027, when he becomes a free agent. Right now, Washington is solely focused on unlocking his defensive potential next season in the hopes of making a postseason run.
